items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: And this particular afternoon, I think Benny Carter was there, and Oscar Peterson, and several different piano players, and they all played, including Oscar.

ctx.x: That's why I mentioned Tatum in the same breath with Phineas. Because Phineas impressed Tatum, but when Tatum sat down to play everybody just stood back amazed -- because Tatum was unbelievable. I remember one time... This story has been told before. I even heard it on Andre Previn's show one night. And it's a true story. This is several years later.

Eddie Beal and I used to share an apartment on Wilton Place. And this particular afternoon, I think Benny Carter was there, and Oscar Peterson, and several different piano players, and they all played, including Oscar. When they got through, Tatum sat down, and his first thing was "Little Man You've Had a Busy Day." That was a put-on for these guys. Then he sat down and wiped everybody out! Those are some of the moments you don't forget.
I think I heard about that from somebody who was there. Was Jimmy there? Seems like Jimmy Talbert told the story.
